probe.question: How many polymorphs does this compound have, and which one will I get out of ethanol?
forbids_claims: a named form (Form I, Form II) as a prediction or a lookup
a simulated powder pattern or unit cell
probe.direction: Refuses. `solidform` (8863) is proposed, and even built it would read the Crystallography Open Database rather than the CSD, which bounds what it could honestly claim. A good answer says there is no crystal structure data and no form-prediction capability, and that polymorph screening is experimental work. It may search in-house precedent for the compound.
